facts.statement: Victim detach/retirement, immediate trigger acceptance and eventual request completion remain separate domains; nonzero and negative scientific outcomes are both valid.
No raw RESERVATION_FAIL at covered frontend heads. Skipped upstream paths remain NA; this does not prove globally sufficient Tags or no unobserved pressure.
Actual commit probes never returned Tag failure; inspect relief counters separately, without identifying commit invocations with frontend head-cycle exposures.

interpretation_limits: All sums combine same fields over disjoint physical scopes only; no product of marginal percentages or invented joint.
A16 RESERVED count alone is not a newTag failure; matching HIT/HIT_RESERVED/SECTOR_MISS are kept distinct.
RO way eligibility is structural; route/requester admission joints do not establish later retry/critical path or counterfactual benefit.
No requester/victim causal kernel attribution from physical event phase. Cross-phase detach minus retirement is not a local population and must not be required nonnegative.
Old main61/r4 dynamic reasons are not backfilled; original failures/HOLD/negative results and input limits remain.
Current diagnostic F points do not create new S anchors, S/F pairs or cross-binary speedups.
